title: 成交同步幂等与冲突重放 · Trade-sync replay safety
agentPrompt: 修复成交事件重复、乱序和冲突重放。相同事件相同载荷必须幂等；相同事件或成交号携带不同不可变字段必须拒绝；Inbox 与成交投影必须处于同一事务。 / Repair duplicate, out-of-order and conflicting trade-event delivery with database-backed idempotency.
publicChecks: 同事件同载荷只产生一个投影 / identical replay creates one projection
同事件不同载荷明确失败 / conflicting replay is rejected
乱序事件可独立收敛 / out-of-order delivery converges
Inbox 与投影原子提交 / inbox and projection commit atomically
requiredEvidence: 数据库唯一性说明 / uniqueness proof
并发与回滚测试 / concurrency and rollback tests
